units.name: Decision Sciences and Management Information Systems
units.evidence: The current official department directory places Tan Yinliang (Ricky) in Decision Sciences and Management Information Systems. His complete official publication list explicitly names 2025 research on quality management in supply chains and brand spillover in a co-opetitive supply chain, as well as online service operations platforms, food-delivery service innovation, supplier sourcing, retailer capacity and inventory planning. These substantive research topics establish Operations Management and Supply Chain scope independently of journal names, rankings or degree credentials.
